# GuizzMods

> GuizzMods is a multilingual catalog for discovering and downloading Minecraft mods, add-ons, textures, shaders, maps, skins, and other community content.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://guizz.xyz/en/): featured and latest community content.
- [About](https://guizz.xyz/en/about/): information about GuizzMods.
- [Contact](https://guizz.xyz/en/contact/): public contact channels.
- [Privacy](https://guizz.xyz/en/privacy/): privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://guizz.xyz/en/terms/): terms of use.
- [VIP](https://guizz.xyz/en/vip/): optional supporter benefits and availability.

## Catalog

- [Add-ons](https://guizz.xyz/en/category/addons/)

- [Holoprint](https://guizz.xyz/en/category/holoprint/)
- [Mash-up](https://guizz.xyz/en/category/mash-up/)
